title: Machine Learning Foundations
description: Baselines, splits, metrics, and error slices before complex models.

levels.name: Foundation
levels.description: Can implement a baseline — not only describe it — write the split rule, and report one metric with the unit of the prediction — under written guidance.

levels.name: Apprentice
levels.description: Can justify the split, keep feature choice off the test set, and discuss an error slice in words — who or which rows fail.

levels.name: Practitioner
levels.description: Can independently name the deployment unit (user, day, store, document), implement two validation schemes in code, and write a split spec a teammate can reproduce.

levels.name: Journeyman
levels.description: Can diagnose a leak — a feature known only after the label time, a shuffled split on a user-level outcome — show the leak in a commit then remove it, and produce a spec another engineer can rerun.

levels.name: Mastery Evidence
levels.description: Can review another apprentice's model notebook, name a missing baseline or a test-set peek, and teach when a simple split is the wrong validation on an unfamiliar dataset.
